Unset a channel watermark. Use this tool to unset a channel watermark.

Usage:
  yutu watermark unset [flags]

Examples:
# Unset watermark for a channel
yutu watermark unset --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string   ID of the channel
  -h, --help               help for unset
      --yes                Confirm the operation
